document_title: Be Prepared for a Power Outage
notes: publication_year 2023 taken from the printed cover ('FEMA V-1008/December 2023'). The URL path folder (2024-03) reflects upload date, not publication date - the same pattern confirmed across CYB-003 and the DIS batch. No licence statement inside the PDF; status determined from the Reprint Terms of Use at ready.gov/publications, which require that content, photos, graphics and figures not be altered and that use must not imply FEMA or US Government endorsement. Marked open_license_redistributable rather than public_domain because conditions apply. Cross-domain overlap with DIS-002 was measured and found to be 0.0% on exact 8-grams despite both documents covering generator safety; the concern recorded in section 7.5 of the DIS screening report is therefore not borne out. The sheet mentions learning the signs of carbon monoxide poisoning and advises talking to a doctor about medical devices; ground-truth chunks avoid those passages under section 2.3. document_length is a word count from automated text extraction.

publication_year 2017 derived from the document code printed in the footer, 5123/0407/RV0917 - original April 2007, revision September 2017; no separate date line appears. Licence determined from the CPSC Privacy and Security Notice, which states that web page text, brochures and posters on CPSC websites are public information that may be freely distributed, copied or linked to, provided the use does not state or imply CPSC endorsement and CPSC is credited. Recorded as open_license_redistributable rather than public_domain because CPSC says 'public information' rather than 'public domain' and attaches those two conditions. The same notice warns that images may be licensed from stock providers; only text is stored here, so that restriction does not apply. A second CPSC document (468, What to Know About Generators and CO, March 2022) was evaluated and rejected - see screening report section 4. document_length is a word count from automated text extraction.

document_title: Keep Your Food Safe During Emergencies: Power Outages, Floods and Fires
publisher: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
notes: HTML page, not a PDF. Saved via browser 'Save as -> Webpage, HTML Only' on the download date; the checksum is specific to that capture and a later save may differ. publication_year 2013 taken from the 'Last Updated: Aug 07, 2013' line in the page footer. The page has not been revised in thirteen years, which makes it the most stable item in the corpus but also means the guidance may lag current practice - acceptable here because the dataset tests retrieval reliability, not the currency of food safety advice. Licence determined from the FSIS Policies and Links page, which states that information presented on the FSIS website is in the public domain and that authorisation to reprint is granted, with source credit requested. WARNING: raw text extraction returns roughly 2,655 words, most of it site navigation - hundreds of unrelated menu links such as recall summaries and cooking guides. The figure recorded here counts the main article only. Navigation must be stripped before chunking in Phase 2 or the extraction will produce dozens of menu-text chunks.
